options.b: Climbs down with an acceleration of 4 m/s²

Monkey’s mass m = 40 kg
g = 10 m/s²
Maximum rope tension Tmax = 600 N
Monkey’s acceleration a = 6 m/s².
According to the second law:
T = mg + ma
T = m(g + a)
T = 40(10 + 6)
T = 640 N.
Since T > Tmax, or 640 > 600, the rope will break.

reviews.question: In case of relative equilibrium of a particle with respect to a moving body, the algebraic sum of the projections, on any axis, of all real forces acting on the particle together with the ______ due to base acceleration must be zero.
reviews.explanation:
D’Alembert’s principle of inertial forces:
For a particle in relative equilibrium with a moving body, the projections of all real forces together with inertia force due to base acceleration sum to zero on every axis.
Σ(i=1 to n) Fi + FI = 0,
where FI is the inertia force(−ma_base for a translating frame) and Fi is a real force.

FI − Σ(i=1 to n) Fi = 0.

reviews.question: A particle is moving under the influence of a force F(x) = −k/(2x²) along the positive x-axis. At t = 0 it is at x = 1 m and its velocity is v = 0. What would be its velocity when it reaches x = 0.5 m? Here k = 10⁻² N·m² and the mass of the particle is 10⁻² kg.
reviews.explanation:
F=−k/(2x²),k=m=10⁻² in the stated SI units.
a=F/m=−1/(2x²).
Because a depends on position,use a=v dv/dx:
v dv=−dx/(2x²).
Integrating from x=1,v=0:
v²/2=(1/2)(1/x−1),so v²=1/x−1.
At x=0.5,v²=1.
Speed=1m/s; signed velocity is−1m/s because motion is toward decreasingx.
No listed choice gives signed velocity. If velocity means speed,a is correct.
The printed direct integration of d²x/dt² with respect tox to get dx/dt is invalid.
reviews.sourceExplanation:
From Newton’s Second law of motion the inertia force acting on a body is given by, F = m × 1.
Given F(x) = −k/(2x²) = m × ax.
ax = −k/(m × 2x²) = −1/(2x²).
⇒ ax = d²x/dt² = −1/(2x²).
⇒ v(x) = dx/dt = 1/(2x) + c.
Using the initial conditions x = 1 m, v = 0:
⇒ 0 = 1/2 + c
⇒ c = −1/2.
∴ dx/dt = 1/(2x) − 1/2.
When x = 0.5 m:
v = 1/(2 × 0.5) − 1/2 = 0.5 m/s.

reviews.question: A particle starts from rest with constant acceleration α m/s² and after some time decelerates uniformly at β m/s² until it comes to rest. If the total time between its rest positions is t, the maximum velocity acquired would be:
reviews.explanation:
Let the particle start from rest, u1 = 0.
Acceleration a1 = α m/s² and time = t1.
For time t2 it decelerates with a2 = −β m/s².
Using v = u + at:
Vmax = 0 + αt1. …(1)
0 = Vmax − βt2. …(2)
Thus αt1 = βt2,
t2 = (α/β)t1.
Total time t = t1 + t2. …(3)

reviews.question: A circular disc rolls down an inclined plane without slipping. The ratio of its rotational kinetic energy to total kinetic energy is:
reviews.explanation:
Total kinetic energy=(1/2)Iω²+(1/2)mv².
Rotational kinetic energy=(1/2)Iω².
For a uniform circular disc,I=(1/2)mR².
Usingv=Rω:
Total kinetic energy
=(1/2)×(1/2)mR²×ω²+(1/2)m(Rω)²
=(1/4)mR²ω²+(1/2)mR²ω²
=(3/4)mR²ω².
Rotational kinetic energy
=(1/2)[mR²/2]ω²
=(1/4)mR²ω².
Therefore the rotational-to-total energy ratio is
[(1/4)mR²ω²]/[(1/4)mR²ω²+(1/2)mR²ω²]
=1/3.
